Saini, Advocate for Mr. B.S. Bhalla, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Raghav Garg, Aag, Punjab. Kuldeep Tiwari. J.(Oral) 1.
texts.facts: Through the instant petition, the petitioner craves for indulgence of this Court for his being enlarged on regular bail, in case FIR No.264 dated 27.09.2022, under Sections 450, 458, 459, 460, 379, 148 and 149 of IPC, registered at Police Station Jandiala, District Amritsar. ALLEGATIONS AGAINST THE PETITIONER 2. The allegations against the present petitioner are that he along with other co-accused, on 26.09.2022, at about 10:00 PM, entered into the house of the complainant, and caused multiple injuries to the complainant/victim. Further allegations against the present petitioner are that he snatched the gold, and cash of Rs.34,000/- from the mother of the complainant, and ran away from the spot on their motorcycles. The relevant extract of the FIR reads as under:- "Statement of Sukhdeep Singh son of Ravail Singh, resident of Village Backside Zimidara Dhaba Akalgarh Dhapiana age about 26 years 9878540719. It is stated that I am resident of above said address and am an agriculturist. Few years back Gurmeet Karu wife of Baldev Singh caste Jat Sikh resident of Deri Wala P.S. Tarsika had lodged a case of molestation against me which is pending in the court at Baba Bakala. On 26.9.2022 I went to sleep after eating the food and at about 10.00 PM somebody nock the door and loudly told me to open the door and stated that you will not be spared. I recognize the voice of Balbir Singh son of Baldev Singh and I saw through the window that Balbir Singh, Akashdeep Singh resident of Dairywala and about 5 unknown boys armed with datar and kirpans were pushing my door and were trying to brake it and after breaking the same they came inside and Balbir Singh gave datar blow on the fingers of my right hand and my three fingers were amputated and thereafter Akashdeep Singh gave datar blow on my arm which hit my left arm and I suffered injury on the arm. Thereafter the unknown person started giving blows on my head with their weapons and I suffered injuries and blood was oozing from the wounds and I raised alaram and after hearing the noise my mother Amrik Kaur came and folded the hands before the accused and all the accused took away gold and cash of Rs.34,000 after snatching from my mother and ran away on their motor cycles. My brother Gurjit Singh after hearing the noise came on the spot and got me admitted in her Hargun Hospital Amritsar where I am undergoing treatment. Action be taken. Sukhdeep Singh." 2024:PHHC:028088 - 3- Singh, who has already been granted the concession of regular bail, by Principal Judge, Juvenile Justice Board, vide order dated 16.01.2023. (v) The present petitioner is not involved in any other criminal case. Per contra, the learned State counsel, who is in receipt of advance notice, has placed on record the custody certificate of the petitioner, as issued by the Superintendent of Central Jail, Amritsar.
texts.arguments: A perusal of the custody certificate further reveals that the petitioner is not involved in any other criminal case.
